rendered: Energy density has risen by a factor of about 1.67[1] (from 150 to 250 Wh kg^− 1[2]), since Since their commercial debut in 1991[3]. Battery cost has fallen by a factor of roughly 7.7[4] (from over $1000 kWh^− 1 in 2008[5] to around $130 kWh^− 1 in 2020[6]). These are the review's own starting and end values, so the factors are approximate ratios of those figures.
